summary: Hosted in the south side of the Nancy Rothwell Building (Core 4).

callouts.title: Three Floors
callouts.body: Ground, first, and second floors open all weekend with staffed access points.

callouts.title: South Entrance
callouts.body: Enter via the south side plaza; signage and volunteers will be there to guide you inside on the day.

callouts.title: Makerspace
callouts.body: Bench tools, 3D printers and soldering bays are provided by the Makerspace Team thanks to our ongoing sponsorship relationship.

callouts.title: Power & Wi-Fi
callouts.body: High-capacity Wi-Fi and power strips at every bank of desks.

callouts.title: Quiet Areas
callouts.body: Dedicated rest zones on ground floor for downtime.
